ChihweiLHBird opened PR #15084 from ChihweiLHBird:update-webpki-root-certs to bytecodealliance:main:

This updates two root certificate crates in Cargo.lock:

  • webpki-root-certs 1.0.4 → 1.0.11, to fix RUSTSEC-2026-0383. PR #14900 closed the advisory issue #14893, but it updated only webpki-roots. The only user is ureq in the ort-sys build script, and that script trusts the OS root store. So this part only clears the advisory.
  • webpki-roots 1.0.10 → 1.0.11. This removes two more emSign roots: "emSign ECC Root CA - C3" and "emSign Root CA - C1". wasi-http (default-send-request) and wasi-tls (rustls) use this list at run time.

After this change, both crates have the same 118 roots.

A maintainer needs to add cargo vet entries for both new versions. cargo check --locked passes for wasmtime-wasi-nn (onnx-download), wasmtime-wasi-http, and wasmtime-wasi-tls. Feel free to push to my branch if needed.
